name: AniPhobia
desc:
Welcome to AniPhobia! A game where you have to survive anime characters. Travel alone or with friends as you fight bosses, find weapons, and cause chaos.

To get your gamepass items, go to settings, then gamepasses.
[EXPLOITING WILL LEAD TO A PERMANENT UNAPPEALABLE BAN]
[Remember to follow Roblox ToS, failure to do so will result in punishments with severity depending on the violation]

Keybinds
PC:
[Left Shift] Sprint
[C] Crouch toggle
[F] Flashlight
[R] Reload
[U] Emote
[N] Night vision (if equipped)
[Mouse 3] Throw melee

Console:
[L3] Sprint toggle
[B] Crouch toggle
[DPad Left] Flashlight
[X] Reload
[DPad Up] Emote
[DPad Right] Night vision (if equipped)
[X] Throw melee
